# Test fixtures

Small, generated archives the Rust tests use. None of them carries DRM,
personal data or anything else that is not plain text or a plain image.

| File | What it is | Where it came from |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sample.zip` | Three files in two folders | Generated by `scripts/make_archive_fixtures.py` |
| `traversal.zip` | Two entries whose names try to leave the destination folder (`../escape.txt`, `a/../../escape2.txt`) and one safe entry | Generated by `scripts/make_archive_fixtures.py` |
| `reserved-names.zip` | An entry called `CON` (a Windows device name) and one safe entry | Generated by `scripts/make_archive_fixtures.py` |
| `sample.7z` | Two files, one folder | Generated with NanaZip 7.0 (a 7-Zip fork) |
| `rar4-best-4096kb-txt.rar` | RAR4 archive with one text file | [Roba1993/RAR](https://github.com/Roba1993/RAR) `assets/` (MIT) |
| `rar5-best-32mb-txt.rar` | RAR5 archive with one text file | [Roba1993/RAR](https://github.com/Roba1993/RAR) `assets/` (MIT) |
| `rar5-normal-32mb-txt-png-pw-test.rar` | RAR5 archive whose entries are encrypted (password: `test`) | [Roba1993/RAR](https://github.com/Roba1993/RAR) `assets/` (MIT) |
| `rar5-normal-32mb-txt-png-1mb-pw-test.part1.rar` … `.part3.rar` | A multipart RAR5 set (password: `test`) | [Roba1993/RAR](https://github.com/Roba1993/RAR) `assets/` (MIT) |

The RAR fixtures come from the test assets of the `rar` Rust crate, which is
MIT licensed and publishes archives it generated itself for its own tests.

Regenerate the ZIP fixtures with:

```
python scripts/make_archive_fixtures.py
```
